title: Tools and Retrievers Module
summary: This module provides tools for agents and diverse retriever implementations for efficient document search and processing. It supports advanced retrieval techniques like multi-query, ensemble, and self-query, and integrates with external search services.

nodes.label: Base Tool Abstraction
nodes.title: Base Tool Interface
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental interface for tools that agents can use to interact with the world.

nodes.label: Base Retriever Abstraction
nodes.title: Base Retriever Interface
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental interface for retrieving relevant documents based on a query, serving as a base for various specialized retrieval strategies.

nodes.label: Runnable Interface
nodes.title: Composable Runnable Interface
nodes.description: A generic interface for components that can be invoked, streamed, or batched, enabling flexible composition within larger systems.

nodes.label: Large Language Model
nodes.title: LLM for Text Generation
nodes.description: Provides language understanding and generation capabilities, often used for query transformation, content extraction, or structured output generation.

nodes.label: Prompt Template
nodes.title: Structured Prompt Generation
nodes.description: Structures input for Large Language Models to guide their responses and behavior, ensuring consistent and effective communication.

nodes.label: Vector Store
nodes.title: Vector Embedding Storage
nodes.description: Stores and retrieves vector embeddings, enabling semantic search, similarity operations, and efficient indexing of high-dimensional data.

nodes.label: Embedding Model
nodes.title: Text Embedding Generation
nodes.description: Converts text into numerical vector representations, allowing for semantic comparison and similarity calculations between pieces of text.

nodes.label: Document Object
nodes.title: Content Unit with Metadata
nodes.description: Represents a piece of text content along with associated metadata, serving as the fundamental unit for retrieval and processing pipelines.

nodes.label: Pydantic Data Model
nodes.title: Data Schema Definition
nodes.description: Used for defining and validating data schemas, particularly for tool arguments, structured outputs, and configuration management.

nodes.label: Filter Tool Arguments
nodes.title: Tool Argument Filtering
nodes.description: Utility to filter and extract relevant arguments from a function's signature for tool creation, ensuring correct input parsing.

nodes.label: Infer Tool Schema
nodes.title: Tool Argument Schema Inference
nodes.description: Infers a Pydantic schema for tool arguments from a Runnable's input type, facilitating structured tool calls and validation.

nodes.label: Custom Tool Decorator
nodes.title: Create Custom Tools
nodes.description: A decorator to easily create custom tools from functions, automatically inferring schemas and adding metadata for agent use.

nodes.label: Handle Deprecated Tool Imports
nodes.title: Backward Compatibility for Tools
nodes.description: Manages backward-compatible imports for classic tools, redirecting users to `langchain_community` to ensure future compatibility.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Retriever Function
nodes.title: Async Document Retrieval
nodes.description: Provides an asynchronous function for a retriever tool to efficiently fetch and format documents, supporting non-blocking operations.

nodes.label: Ensemble Retriever
nodes.title: Combine Multiple Retrievers
nodes.description: Combines results from multiple underlying retrievers using weighted reciprocal rank fusion for improved relevance and recall.

nodes.label: Multi-Query Retriever
nodes.title: Generate & Combine Multiple Queries
nodes.description: Generates multiple diverse queries from a single input using an LLM, then retrieves and combines documents from each for broader coverage.

nodes.label: Multi-Vector Retriever
nodes.title: Retrieve Parent Docs from Chunks
nodes.description: Retrieves full parent documents by performing similarity searches on smaller, embedded child chunks, maintaining context.

nodes.label: Self-Query Retriever
nodes.title: LLM-Guided Structured Query
nodes.description: Uses an LLM to construct structured queries for a vector store based on natural language input, including filters and limits.

nodes.label: LLM Chain Document Extractor
nodes.title: Extract Relevant Document Parts
nodes.description: Compresses documents by extracting only the most relevant parts using an LLM chain, reducing noise and focusing on key information.

nodes.label: LLM Chain Document Filter
nodes.title: Filter Documents by Relevance
nodes.description: Filters out documents that are not relevant to a given query using an LLM chain, improving precision and reducing irrelevant data.

nodes.label: Cohere Rerank Compressor
nodes.title: Rerank Documents with Cohere
nodes.description: Reranks a list of documents based on their relevance to a query using the Cohere Rerank API, enhancing search result quality.

nodes.label: Cohere Rerank API
nodes.title: External Reranking Service
nodes.description: An external API service provided by Cohere for advanced document reranking capabilities.

nodes.label: Semantic Similarity Example Selector
nodes.title: Select Examples by Similarity
nodes.description: Selects relevant examples from a collection based on their semantic similarity to a given input query, useful for few-shot prompting.

nodes.label: Max Marginal Relevance Example Selector
nodes.title: Select Diverse Examples (MMR)
nodes.description: Selects a diverse set of examples from a collection using Max Marginal Relevance, balancing relevance and diversity for better context.

nodes.label: Exa Search Retriever
nodes.title: Retrieve from Exa Web Search
nodes.description: Retrieves web search results from the Exa API, providing structured documents based on a query for RAG applications.

nodes.label: Exa Search Results Tool
nodes.title: Perform Exa Web Search
nodes.description: A tool that performs web searches using the Exa API and returns the results in a structured JSON format for agents.

nodes.label: Exa Find Similar Tool
nodes.title: Find Similar Web Pages (Exa)
nodes.description: A tool that uses the Exa API to find web pages similar to a given URL, useful for content discovery.

nodes.label: Exa Search API
nodes.title: External Web Search Service
nodes.description: An external API service provided by Exa for advanced web search and content retrieval, enhancing agent capabilities.

nodes.label: Perplexity Search Retriever
nodes.title: Retrieve from Perplexity AI Search
nodes.description: Retrieves search results from the Perplexity AI API, offering AI-powered search capabilities for comprehensive information gathering.

nodes.label: Perplexity AI API
nodes.title: External AI Search Service
nodes.description: An external API service provided by Perplexity AI for AI-powered search and answer generation, enhancing retrieval.

groups.label: Tool Definition & Management
groups.title: Tool Definition & Management
groups.description: Components for defining, creating, and managing tools that agents can utilize, including schema inference and handling deprecated imports.

groups.label: Retriever Orchestration & Core
groups.title: Retriever Orchestration & Core
groups.description: Core retriever implementations and orchestration strategies, enabling advanced document retrieval techniques like multi-query, ensemble, and self-query.

groups.label: Document Processing & Compression
groups.title: Document Processing & Compression
groups.description: Components focused on processing and compressing documents, including LLM-based extraction and filtering, and external reranking services.

groups.label: Example Selection
groups.title: Example Selection
groups.description: Mechanisms for selecting relevant and diverse examples from a collection, typically used for few-shot prompting, based on semantic similarity or MMR.

groups.label: External Search Integrations
groups.title: External Search Integrations
groups.description: Integrations with external search APIs like Exa and Perplexity AI, providing specialized web search and information retrieval capabilities.
